id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation.

confirmation_code.description: The human-readable confirmation code for the reservation.

status.description: The current status of the reservation.

listing_id.description: The identifier of the listing that was booked.

nights.description: The total number of nights in the reservation.

guests_count.description: The number of guests included in the reservation.

total_price.description: The total price of the reservation in the listing currency.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the reservation pricing.

host_payout.description: The amount to be paid out to the host after fees.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the reservation was last updated.
